payload.title: fgos-plan-loop / coordination session bug: a declared-protocol session whose open.json declares…
payload.description: fgos-plan-loop / coordination session bug: a declared-protocol session whose open.json declares the full doer/reviewer/red-team/fixer roster (per fgos-plan-loop's 'every request repeats actors[] verbatim' convention) but only dispatches reviewer+red-team steps (a code:review-only cell with no produce-candidate) can never close — closeSessionByQuorum requires every actor in manifest.actors, partialPolicy can only be declared at session OPEN (session-engine.mjs R1, openParams only applied via findExistingManifest ?? openSession on the FIRST request for a coordinationId), so a later fix-N.json/close.json cannot retroactively add partialPolicy.allowedOmissions to unstick it. Repro: open a declared-protocol session with actors=[doer,reviewer,red-team,fixer] but steps targeting only reviewer/red-team; closeSessionByQuorum refuses with 'missing required actor(s) [doer, fixer] and declares no partialPolicy'. Confirmed live 2026-09-10 on rust-host-r1-kernel--cell-01 (P00 cell). Fix direction: either fgos-plan-loop's review-only-phase guidance should tell the Lead to declare ONLY the actors a review-only cell's steps actually target (requiredActorIds derives straight from manifest.actors, session-engine.mjs:3415), or open.json authoring should always pair a review-only cell's actors[] with an explicit partialPolicy.allowedOmissions up front.
payload.verify: chưa xác định — P15 bổ sung

payload.title: fgos coordination run bug: dependent operation steps (review-candidate/red-team-candidate with…
payload.description: fgos coordination run bug: dependent operation steps (review-candidate/red-team-candidate with contextRefs: [$ref:produce]) dispatch and complete even when the produce step's own assignment tracking reports 'failed' with 'agent prompt produced no observed state change within 5000 ms' — but the underlying herdr pane keeps running and the Doer's real work lands LATER (after the dependent steps already settled). Confirmed live 2026-09-10 on rust-host-r1-kernel--p04: doer assignment op_009 failed at 11:29:05 (9s duration, dispatch-briefing timeout, not a real content failure), reviewer op_010 settled 11:32:35 ('agent-result.json failed schema validation'), red-team op_012 settled 11:36:28 (falsely claimed 'all attacks passed, no defect' against effectively empty state), but the doer's real commit (37321ec5, Cargo workspace skeleton, later independently verified clean by the Lead) did not land until 11:37:06 -- AFTER both dependent steps had already run and reported against stale/absent state. Consequence: a review-only recheck session had to be opened from scratch since the original reviewer/red-team results were meaningless (reviewed nothing). Fix direction: dependent operation steps whose contextRefs reference a failed produce assignment should refuse to dispatch (fail closed) rather than proceeding against stale state; separately, the doer's own briefing-timeout detection (5000ms 'no observed state change') may be too aggressive relative to how long a herdr pane can legitimately take to start visibly acting, causing a false-failed status on work that is in fact proceeding.
payload.verify: chưa xác định — P15 bổ sung
